scope: Separate software-incident collection-pattern transfer diagnostic; not hardware-wallet validation
selection: Exactly the earliest confirmed positive receipt block of each of the two published collectors, pooled once; fixed before full-block retrieval. Sparse case-conditioned snapshot, not the full incident window.
tie_policy: Report best=1+strictly_greater and worst=greater+equal scores; no address-based rank advantage
include: Positive-value decoded-address outputs of non-coinbase transactions; include change, exclude zero-value outputs
unknown_policy: All non-reference recipients remain unattributed, not certified legitimate

incident_source.evidence: Research attribution, not independently verified device or owner control; reported victim corroboration does not label every source address

public_manifest_note: Public reduction after extraction: reference addresses resolve from the pre-existing checksummed registry; block selection and scores remain unchanged
